newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Star Banc downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Star Banc downgraded.

text.p: -- McDonald & Co said Thursday it had downgraded Star Banc Corp to a buy from aggressive buy.
-- Star Banc is currently trading at about 14.8 times McDonald & Co's 1996 earnings estimate of $5.40 a share and 13 times the 1997 estimate of $6.15.
-- "We believe a 13 (times) forward multiple is reasonable based on Star's 19 percent estimated (earnings per share) growth rate this year and 14 percent for 1997," McDonald & Co said in a report.
